commands.name: AUTH
commands.summary: Authenticate the connection when a password is configured.
commands.reply: OK on success; an error otherwise.

commands.name: CLIENT
commands.summary: Answer the CLIENT subcommands RESP3 client handshakes send.
commands.reply: OK for CLIENT SETINFO; an error for unknown subcommands.

commands.name: CONFIG
commands.summary: Read or live-tune runtime configuration parameters.
commands.reply: GET replies with flat name/value pairs; SET replies OK or an error.

commands.name: EMB
commands.summary: Generate embeddings for one or more texts of one model.
commands.reply: One text: a bulk string of float32 bytes (BLOB) or a VALUES envelope. Several texts under BLOB: an array of the same in request order. Several texts under VALUES: one envelope with shape [count, dim].

commands.name: EMB.CACHE.FLUSH
commands.summary: Invalidate all cached embeddings, or one model's.
commands.reply: Integer count of removed entries.

commands.name: EMB.EVAL
commands.summary: Evaluate a Lua script once against a model.
commands.reply: The script's converted value, or an array of values for several texts.

commands.name: EMB.EVSHA
commands.summary: Evaluate a cached script by SHA1.
commands.reply: The script's converted value, or an array of values for several texts.

commands.name: EMB.HELP
commands.summary: Show the command reference, including the script surface.
commands.reply: A bulk string of help lines.

commands.name: EMB.IMG
commands.summary: Embed one or more raw encoded images of one model.
commands.reply: One image: a keyed map of output name to value; several: an array of such maps in request order, with null for a failed or truncated slot.

oneOf.description: one image that failed or was truncated
one image: output name to that output's value
several images, one keyed map per image in request order

commands.wire_notes: RESP2 writes each map as a flat alternating name/value array; RESP3 writes a map. VALUES replaces each bulk string with a dtype/shape/values envelope.

commands.name: EMB.IMGMULTI
commands.summary: Embed images across different models in one call.
commands.reply: An array with one keyed map per pair in request order; a failed pair is null; under VALUES each pair carries its model beside its outputs.

reply_schema.description: one keyed map per model/image pair in request order

commands.wire_notes: RESP2 writes each map as a flat alternating name/value array; RESP3 writes a map. VALUES replaces each bulk string with a dtype/shape/values envelope.

commands.name: EMB.INFO
commands.summary: Show one model's configuration and statistics.
commands.reply: A map of model fields: dim, workers, latency, CPU plan, embed/image/script phases, image outputs, and cache stats.

commands.name: EMB.MODELS
commands.summary: List loaded models with dimensions and status.
commands.reply: RESP2: an array of [name, dim, status]; RESP3: a map keyed by model name with dim and status.

commands.name: EMB.MULTI
commands.summary: Embed texts across different models in one round trip.
commands.reply: An array with one vector (or VALUES envelope) per pair in request order; a failed pair is null.

commands.name: EMB.READY
commands.summary: Report server readiness.
commands.reply: +OK when ready; an error naming loading, draining, or no models.

commands.name: EMB.SAVE
commands.summary: Accept an asynchronous cache snapshot.
commands.reply: OK once the snapshot is accepted; an error when persistence is disabled or disallowed.

commands.name: EMB.SCRIPT
commands.summary: Compile, inspect, and flush cached Lua scripts.
commands.grammar: EMB.SCRIPT LOAD <model> <script> | EMB.SCRIPT EXISTS <model> <sha...> | EMB.SCRIPT FLUSH [<model>]
commands.reply: LOAD replies a bulk SHA1; EXISTS replies an array of 1/0 per SHA; FLUSH replies OK.

commands.name: EMB.STATS
commands.summary: Show server-wide statistics.
commands.reply: A map of uptime, requests, per-model breakdown, CPU, cache, connections, memory, and goroutines.

commands.name: HELLO
commands.summary: Negotiate the RESP protocol version for the connection.
commands.reply: A map (flat array under RESP2) with server, version, proto, mode, and role.

commands.name: INFO
commands.summary: Show Redis-style server information sections.
commands.reply: A bulk string of CRLF-separated sections.

commands.name: MONITOR
commands.summary: Show recent completed request events.
commands.reply: An array of events, each a 12-field flat array under RESP2 or a map under RESP3; no text payloads.

commands.name: PING
commands.summary: Redis compatibility ping.
commands.reply: Simple string PONG.

commands.name: SHUTDOWN
commands.summary: Stop the server with Redis's shutdown semantics.
commands.reply: No reply: the caller blocks and the connection closes. SHUTDOWN ABORT replies OK or an error.
